name: Nitrogen Fixation (Mo-dependent)
notes: Molybdenum-dependent nitrogen fixation via nitrogenase enzyme complex. The most common nitrogenase system. Reduces N2 to NH3 using the nifHDK complex with a molybdenum-iron cofactor (FeMo-co). nifH is the Fe protein (electron donor), nifD and nifK form the MoFe protein (catalytic component).

nodes.name: nitrogenase complex (Mo-dependent)
nodes.notes: Complete Mo-nitrogenase complex: nifH (Fe protein) + nifD (MoFe alpha) + nifK (MoFe beta). All three subunits required. KEGG: K02588+K02586+K02591

scoring.notes: All three genes (nifH, nifD, nifK) required for functional Mo-nitrogenase. All are markers.
